scenarios.title: Backend connection from Server settings
scenarios.expected: Default server works without a permission step; /health reports ok
scenarios.actual: Server settings -> Check connection: "Connected to the Aamen server." (default server, no permission prompt needed)

scenarios.title: Analyze an open Terms and Conditions page
scenarios.expected: Extract -> service worker -> backend -> AI -> PDPL -> result with rating, summary and warnings
scenarios.actual: Result in 19.9s: safety 10/100, High risk, 6 warnings; cache rows = 1

scenarios.title: View Details report with PDPL references
scenarios.expected: Full report of every clause with PDPL assessment and official links; closes back to the popup
scenarios.actual: View Details opened: 6 clauses, 9 Saudi PDPL references with official links; Esc closes it

scenarios.title: Homepage: follow the site's legal links
scenarios.expected: Terms and Privacy links are found and both documents analyzed
scenarios.actual: Homepage has no legal text; the popup followed its Terms and Privacy links and analyzed both in 18.4s: High risk, 7 warnings

scenarios.title: Save preferences (popup -> WP6 database)
scenarios.expected: Unsaved changes shown; Save stores them; not-accepted topics are stored as extra attention
scenarios.actual: Accepted photos + banking and pressed Save. GET /preferences = {"location": true, "photos": false, "banking_information": false, "third_party_sharing": true}

scenarios.title: Exit without saving
scenarios.actual: Changed Location to Accept, closed without saving, reopened: Location is still Don't accept, the server is unchanged

scenarios.title: Saved preferences used in the next analysis, then cache
scenarios.expected: New analysis with WP4 personalization (cache MISS); same request again is a cache HIT
scenarios.actual: New preferences -> new analysis (cache MISS, rows 2->3) in 20.8s: High risk, "Your choices changed the rating by 5 points". Same page again: cache HIT in 0.1s (rows unchanged)

scenarios.title: Popup closed during the analysis
scenarios.expected: Reopened popup shows the running analysis and then its result
scenarios.actual: Popup closed right after the analysis started and reopened 2 s later: it showed the running analysis, then the result (Moderate, 4 warnings) for "Analyzed page: Privacy Policy — Rihla Delivery"

scenarios.title: Arabic interface with pasted text
scenarios.expected: Pasted text analyzed; result and report shown right-to-left in Arabic
scenarios.actual: Pasted fictional DOC-C (PayNest Wallet) with the Arabic interface: متوسط, ٨ تحذيرات in 18.8s

scenarios.title: Error messages
scenarios.expected: Clear messages for server down, no API key (EN/AR), short text, no legal text, offline
scenarios.actual: server down -> "Can’t reach the server" + Open server settings; no API key (HTTP 503) -> "Analysis isn’t set up yet" / "التحليل غير مفعّل بعد"; too short -> "Add at least 50 characters before analyzing."; no legal text -> "No legal text found" + Paste text instead; offline -> "No internet connection"

scenarios.title: Preferences saved while the server is down
scenarios.expected: Saved on the device, then sent to the server before the next analysis
scenarios.actual: Saved with the server down: "Saved on this device. They will be sent to the server before your next analysis.". Next analysis sent them first: location True -> False, then analyzed in 9.0s

analysis_timings.analysis: pasted DOC-A after an offline save
